 CHESTER— New evidence has been discovered in the five-month-old case of Chester therapist Brooke Hanlon who was believed to have been killed in her Pottersville Road home in June, according to published reports.
 Reportedly detectives discovered DNA in the home that did not belong to either the victim or her husband James “Conor” Hanlon. However, they have not been able to make any identification at this time.
